uuid/generation#

RFC-compatible UUID generation that does not depend on host UUID libraries.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let dns = UuidText(origin: "6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8");
let legacy is Uuid = Uuid3(namespace: dns, name: "example.com");
let stable is Uuid = Uuid5(namespace: dns, name: "example.com");
let custom is Uuid = Uuid8(high: 1, middle: 2, low: 3);
let random is Uuid = Uuid4s(random: SecureRandom()).sample();

Description#

RFC-compatible UUID generation that does not depend on host UUID libraries. Each maker is itself a Uuid:

UUID 3 hashes namespace bytes followed by the exact UTF-8 name with MD5. UUID 5 does the same with SHA-1 and retains its first 128 bits. Both then set their version and RFC variant bits. The hash is computed once, on the first question.

UUID 8 exposes all 122 custom bits explicitly: high is the most-significant 48 bits, middle is 12 bits after the version field, and low is the final 62 bits after the variant field. All three inputs are unsigned and bounded.

UUID 7 is intentionally absent until time/clock supplies a wall-clock Instant contract. Its generator must retain a shared monotonic per-millisecond counter. UUID 1 and UUID 6 are excluded from v3 until a privacy-preserving explicit node-identity capability is approved.
